title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
summary: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.
title_es: Anthropic advierte estar cerca de capacidad de auto-mejora en IA
bajada: Anthropic señala que está próxima a lograr RSI (Recursive Self-Improvement), el punto donde la IA se mejora a sí misma generando una aceleración exponencial de capacidades. Este hito representa uno de los mayores puntos de inflexión teóricos en el desarrollo de IA.
bajada_en: Anthropic warns it's approaching RSI (Recursive Self-Improvement), the point where AI improves itself, triggering exponential acceleration of capabilities. This milestone represents one of the biggest theoretical inflection points in AI development.

title: Anthropic reveals $900B AI spending commitments ahead of IPO
title_es: Anthropic revela compromisos de $900B en gasto de IA
bajada: La compañía reveló planes de inversión masiva de $900B en infraestructura de IA antes de su IPO proyectado. El anuncio subraya la escala sin precedentes de capex que demanda el desarrollo de modelos de frontera.
bajada_en: The company revealed $900B in AI spending commitments ahead of its planned IPO. The announcement underscores the unprecedented capex scale required for frontier model development.

title: Oracle files to sell $20B in new stock, bonds to finance AI buildout
title_es: Oracle levanta $20B para financiar expansión de infraestructura IA
bajada: Oracle anunció la venta de $20B en acciones y bonos para financiar su buildout de IA. La megainversión refleja la competencia feroz entre tech gigantes por dominar la capacidad de cómputo necesaria para entrenar modelos de última generación.
bajada_en: Oracle announced a $20B offering in stock and bonds to finance its AI infrastructure expansion. The mega-investment reflects fierce competition among tech giants for compute capacity needed to train frontier models.

title: AI Models Are Getting Harder to Monitor, Says U.K. Government’s Joseph Bloom
summary: The ability to monitor AI models to detect what they’re trying to do and why is widely considered a crucial part of the effort to keep the technology operating safely. It’s also increasingly hard to do, said Joseph Bloom, the head of model transparency at the U.K. AI Security Institute.“In general, we’re seeing monitorability—in various respects or from various angles—decrease,” Bloom said on the latest episode of The Information’s AI Deep Dive, in one of the first on-the-record interviews that a member of technical staff at AISI has given. (The full episode is available here.) The institute is one of the world’s largest government bodies focused on AI, and its work includes evaluating models from leading AI companies.
title_es: Gobiernos advierten que los modelos de IA son cada vez más opacos
bajada: El jefe de transparencia del Instituto de Seguridad de IA del Reino Unido advierte que monitorear modelos para detectar sus comportamientos es cada vez más difícil. La falta de interpretabilidad plantea desafíos críticos para la regulación y seguridad de IA.
bajada_en: The U.K. AI Security Institute's head of model transparency warns that monitoring AI models to understand their behavior is increasingly difficult. Lack of interpretability poses critical challenges for AI regulation and safety.

title: The New York Times sues Brave web browser for AI scraping and bypassing paywalls
summary: The New York Times and a group of other publications have filed lawsuits against the company that makes the Brave web browser over alleged unlawful scraping to train AI and also letting users bypass their paywalls, as reported by Reuters. According to a complaint filed by the New York Daily News, the Chicago Tribune, and […]
title_es: NYT demanda a Brave por scraping de IA y bypass de paywalls
bajada: The New York Times y otros medios demandaron a Brave por extraer contenido para entrenar IA y permitir a usuarios eludir paywalls. La acción legal reabre la batalla sobre derechos de autor en datos de entrenamiento de IA.
bajada_en: The New York Times and other publishers sued Brave for scraping content to train AI and allowing users to bypass paywalls. The legal action reopens the battle over copyright in AI training data.

title: Last night an AI agent performed brain surgery on a mouse
title_es: Agente de IA realizó cirugía cerebral en ratón
bajada: Un agente de IA realizó exitosamente una intervención quirúrgica de precisión en un ratón. El logro demuestra capacidades emergentes en aplicaciones médicas de IA y robotótica autónoma.
bajada_en: An AI agent successfully performed precision brain surgery on a mouse. The achievement demonstrates emerging capabilities in AI medical applications and autonomous robotics.

title: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
summary: The one-year-old startup is now valued at $300 million.
title_es: Trajectory recauda $45M para democratizar el entrenamiento de modelos
bajada: La startup Trajectory, valorada en $300M, busca hacer accesible el entrenamiento de modelos de IA a usuarios sin experiencia técnica. La ronda de inversión señala demanda creciente por herramientas de IA más inclusivas.
bajada_en: Trajectory, valued at $300M, raised $45M to make AI model training accessible to non-technical users. The funding round signals growing demand for more inclusive AI tools.

title: Scaling Git at OpenAI
summary: How OpenAI built Pando, a Git-compatible backend designed for the scale of development that Codex makes possible.
title_es: OpenAI presenta Pando, backend Git para escala masiva
bajada: OpenAI compartió cómo construyó Pando, un backend compatible con Git diseñado para manejar la escala de desarrollo que habilita Codex. La herramienta es crítica para gestionar repositorios en proyectos de IA a gran escala.
bajada_en: OpenAI shared how it built Pando, a Git-compatible backend designed for the development scale enabled by Codex. The tool is critical for managing repositories in large-scale AI projects.

title: LifeVal
summary: Introducing LifeVal, a benchmark measuring how well AI helps people complete everyday tasks, from finding childcare to managing finances and government paperwork.
title_es: OpenAI lanza LifeVal, benchmark para tareas cotidianas
bajada: OpenAI introdujo LifeVal, un benchmark que mide qué tan bien la IA ayuda a las personas con tareas diarias como buscar cuidado infantil o gestionar finanzas. El benchmark establece nuevos estándares para evaluar utilidad práctica de modelos.
bajada_en: OpenAI introduced LifeVal, a benchmark measuring how well AI helps with everyday tasks like finding childcare or managing finances. The benchmark sets new standards for evaluating practical model usefulness.

title: Anthropic's internal AI use, at retail prices, now exceeds its employee pay
title_es: Uso interno de IA en Anthropic supera gasto en salarios
bajada: El costo del uso interno de Claude de Anthropic, a precios minoristas, ya supera el total de salarios de empleados. El dato ilustra cómo las compañías de IA están consumiendo masivamente sus propios productos.
bajada_en: Anthropic's internal Claude usage cost, at retail prices, now exceeds total employee payroll. The figure illustrates how AI companies are consuming massive amounts of their own products.

title: Claude Opus 5.5 Can Draw Permit-Level Architectural Drawings
title_es: Claude Opus 5.5 genera planos arquitectónicos a nivel profesional
bajada: Claude Opus 5.5 puede ahora generar planos arquitectónicos detallados de calidad profesional. El avance muestra que modelos de IA alcanzan nivel de competencia en tareas técnicas especializadas.
bajada_en: Claude Opus 5.5 can now generate detailed permit-level architectural drawings. The breakthrough shows AI models reaching professional-grade competence in specialized technical tasks.

title: Rewarding defenders with bigger bug bounties
summary: OpenAI is raising Security Bug Bounty rewards and introducing report quality, loyalty, and priority campaign bonuses for independent security researchers.
title_es: OpenAI aumenta recompensas de bug bounty para investigadores
bajada: OpenAI incrementó sus recompensas de seguridad e introdujo bonos por calidad de reporte, lealtad y campañas prioritarias para investigadores independientes. El movimiento busca fortalecer la seguridad a través de crowdsourcing.
bajada_en: OpenAI raised security bug bounty rewards and introduced bonuses for report quality, loyalty, and priority campaigns for independent researchers. The move aims to strengthen security through crowdsourcing.

title: Preparing our next security sprint to harden OpenAI
summary: OpenAI is preparing its next internal security sprint with Cathedral Systems to test and strengthen its defenses using AI.
title_es: OpenAI prepara sprint de seguridad con Cathedral Systems
bajada: OpenAI anunció un sprint interno de seguridad con Cathedral Systems para probar y fortalecer defensas usando IA. La iniciativa refleja el enfoque proactivo de la compañía en hardening de infraestructura.
bajada_en: OpenAI announced an internal security sprint with Cathedral Systems to test and strengthen defenses using AI. The initiative reflects the company's proactive approach to infrastructure hardening.

title: Introducing the Grid Protectors Program
summary: OpenAI’s Grid Protectors Program will work with utilities to help future compute campuses support grid reliability and protect consumer electricity costs.
title_es: OpenAI lanza programa para fortalecer confiabilidad de red eléctrica
bajada: El Grid Protectors Program de OpenAI trabajará con empresas de servicios para asegurar que futuras campus de cómputo apoyen la estabilidad de la red eléctrica. La iniciativa aborda preocupaciones crecientes sobre consumo energético de IA.
bajada_en: OpenAI's Grid Protectors Program will work with utilities to ensure future compute campuses support grid reliability. The initiative addresses growing concerns about AI's energy consumption.

title: Anthropic clamps down on Claude’s AI video game clones
summary: Anthropic has updated Claude Code's system prompt to prevent the AI tool from being used to re-create existing video games, as reported by Tom's Hardware. Retro gaming is currently being overrun with AI-made decompilations, recompilations, and ports, but while Anthropic will still let people use Claude Code to make games, it doesn't want people to […]
title_es: Anthropic restringe uso de Claude para clonar videojuegos
bajada: Anthropic actualizó el prompt de Claude Code para prevenir que se use en recrear videojuegos existentes. La restricción busca frenar la sobrepoblación de clones de juegos retro generados por IA.
bajada_en: Anthropic updated Claude Code's system prompt to prevent recreating existing video games. The restriction aims to curb the proliferation of AI-generated retro game clones.
